name: Green-headed duck
summary: Green-headed duck, one of the three plates Bản Hịch cooks, about 12 km from the old district center.
origin: The rural-tourism feature for Bản Hịch.
where: Bản Hịch. The rural feature places the village in xã Mai Hịch, about 12 km from the old district center. Resolution 1676 puts Mai Hịch into xã Bao La, and Báo Phú Thọ says bản Hịch is in xã Bao La.
seoTitle: Vit dau xanh at Ban Hich — green-headed duck
seoDescription: Vịt đầu xanh is green-headed duck, one of the three plates of Bản Hịch, about 12 km from the old Mai Châu center.
